description: This file contains the implementation of ClaimsBasedAuthorizationService, a class that performs authorization decisions based on asserted claims within a HonoUser object. It includes methods to determine if a user is authorized for specific resources and activities or operations.

classes.name: ClaimsBasedAuthorizationService
classes.description: A final class implementing AuthorizationService that makes authorization decisions based on claims/asserted information within a HonoUser.

methods.name: isAuthorized (HonoUser user, ResourceIdentifier resource, Activity intent)
methods.description: Checks if the user is authorized for a specific activity on a resource, returning a Future Boolean.

methods.name: isAuthorized (HonoUser user, ResourceIdentifier resource, String operation)
methods.description: Checks if the user is authorized for a specific operation on a resource, returning a Future Boolean.
